note: Light a character can carry. kinds: the light each gives (feet, by the 5e book). items: SRD item indexes (an item's name in lowercase with dashes also matches) with the kind they give and mode: lit = somebody lights it (and puts it out), held = it shines while it is wielded. needsItem kinds are refused unless the character carries and wields that item.

lantern-hooded.how: light it (it burns for 6 hours on a pint of oil)

lantern-bullseye.how: light it (it burns for 6 hours on a pint of oil)

flame-tongue.how: a bonus action and its command word ignite or douse the blade

sun-blade.how: a bonus action makes the blade of radiance appear or vanish

mace-of-disruption.how: it sheds light while it is held

lantern-of-revealing.how: light it (it burns for 6 hours on a pint of oil)
